about_description: Add your own game shelves to the Home screen, built from collections, library tabs or filters, and manage them from the Quick Access Menu.
about_feature_advanced_groups: Create advanced filter groups with AND/OR and nested rules
about_feature_api: Other plugins can connect to Deck Shelves and share their data
about_feature_atomic_settings: Settings are saved safely, with a backup, so they don't get corrupted
about_feature_ci_tests: More automated tests, so fewer bugs reach a release
about_feature_compat: Displays Steam Deck compatibility badges on game cards
about_feature_developer_filter: Developer / Publisher filter that lists the studios found in your library
about_feature_duplicate: Duplicate shelves to quickly create variations
about_feature_dynamic_sizing: Cards match the size of Steam's own cards, also with CSS Loader themes
about_feature_edit_smart: Edit smart shelves: override sort, add extra filters, tweak visuals
about_feature_external_imports: Turn library tabs from TabMaster or other plugins into shelves
about_feature_filters: Filter by name, playtime, install status, compatibility, visibility, and more
about_feature_first_run: First-run banner with the setup wizard
about_feature_global_toggles: Turn on "Match native card size" and "Highlight first game" for every shelf, or set them per shelf
about_feature_hero_global: One toggle in the Quick Access Menu turns on hero art for every shelf
about_feature_hero_per_shelf: Hero background art for any shelf, set in the Visual tab of the shelf editor
about_feature_hide_recents: Hide native Recent Games section with optional hero background art
about_feature_highlight_first: Highlight first game as a landscape featured card
about_feature_import_export: Import and export shelf configurations as JSON files
about_feature_manual_base_sort: Manual sort: pick the base order (playtime, release date…) for games you haven't placed
about_feature_mouse_hover: With a mouse, hovering a card shows its label and highlight
about_feature_new_filters: New filter options: playtime ranges, regex name matching, store tags, achievements
about_feature_new_sorts: Additional sort options: playtime, release date, size, review scores
about_feature_online_cloud_play: Online shelves can keep cloud-only games visible (e.g. Xbox Cloud Gaming through UnifiDeck), for every shelf or per shelf
about_feature_online_shelves: Online shelves: surface your Steam wishlist and active store deals as live shelves on Home
about_feature_playtime: Shows total playtime on focused game cards
about_feature_refresh: Shelves refresh together, which keeps Home fast
about_feature_saved_filters: Save and reuse filter combos across shelves
about_feature_screenshot_automation: Screenshots for the documentation are taken automatically in every language
about_feature_shelves: Add unlimited custom shelves to the Home screen
about_feature_smart_shelves: Smart shelves: templates that fill themselves and appear or disappear based on your library
about_feature_sort: Sort games alphabetically or by last session
about_feature_sources: Populate shelves from collections, library sections, or advanced filters
about_feature_suspend_resume: Shelves pause while the Deck sleeps and catch up when it wakes
about_feature_templates: Shelf templates (Favorites, Recently Played, Installed, Most Played)
about_feature_unifideck: UnifiDeck integration: surface non-Steam apps as shelf sources
about_feature_visibility: Show or hide individual shelves without deleting them
about_howto_step1: Open the Quick Access Menu (... button) and find Deck Shelves in the plugin list.
about_howto_step2: Toggle the main switch to enable shelves on the Home screen.
about_howto_step3: Tap + to create a shelf: pick a name, a source (collection, library tab or filter) and a game limit.
about_howto_step4: Use the ⋯ button on each shelf to edit, duplicate, reorder, show/hide, or delete it.
about_howto_step5: Use import/export to back up or share your shelf configurations.
about_learn_more_description: Visit the project on GitHub or report an issue / request a feature.
about_support_description: If you enjoy this plugin, consider supporting continued development:
about_kofi_qr_hint: Scan the QR with your phone, or click Ko-fi to open the page in a browser.
about_feature_settings_page: A full Settings page: the left side has every Quick Access toggle, and the right side opens pages for shelves, profiles, integrations, shortcuts, backup and advanced tools.
about_feature_profiles: Profiles save your whole setup (toggles, shelves and filters) under a name. Switch between them in one tap, import or export them, or pick "Default" to go back to factory settings.
about_feature_button_bindings: Change or turn off the buttons that hide, highlight or quick-launch a card, and change the combos for Quick Search and Side Navigation. Single presses, combos (e.g. L1+R1) and double taps (e.g. L1+L1) all work.
about_feature_keyboard_bindings: Every gamepad shortcut can also have its own keyboard key, including modifier combos.
about_feature_screensaver: An optional screensaver of your own: a slideshow of your recent games and shelves (and, if you want, your screenshots) with a game logo you can move and resize. Experimental.
about_feature_cloud_sync: Optional settings sync between your devices through your Steam account, with no extra sign-in or cost (this is not Steam Cloud). Experimental.
about_feature_unified_list: Optionally merge regular and smart shelves into one list, reorder it by dragging or with the ↑ / ↓ buttons, and Home follows that order.
about_feature_drag_reorder: Drag shelves by the ⋮⋮ handle to reorder them in the Shelves panel; the ↑ / ↓ buttons still work with a gamepad.
about_feature_light_mode: Light mode hides the advanced toggles and sliders in the Quick Access Menu for a simpler panel.
about_feature_external_launchers: Games from EmuDeck, RetroDECK, Heroic (Epic / GOG / Amazon), Lutris, Moonlight and Chiaki show up as shelf sources, updated every 15 minutes.
about_feature_integrations_toggle: The Integrations panel lets you turn each integration, built-in or from another plugin, on or off.
about_feature_built_in_chip: Built-in integrations have a green BUILT-IN tag, so you can tell them apart from the ones other plugins add.
about_feature_filter_v3: 32 new filters, such as genres, franchise, VR support, multiplayer type, family sharing, DLC or soundtrack owned, launch count, session length, achievement progress, storage device, install size, external launchers and custom tags, plus weighted, priority and exclusion groups.
about_feature_sort_v3: 25 new sorts, such as most launched, longest session, completion %, rarest achievements, install or purchase date, install size, SSD or SD card first, what your friends play, and several random orders.
about_feature_source_v3: 19 new shelf sources, such as dynamic collections, followed and ignored games, DLC, soundtracks, play history, queues, recently updated games, games with events or workshop updates, and external launchers.
about_feature_grip_buttons: Map the back grip and stick-click buttons (L3, R3, L4, L5, R4, R5) to card shortcuts
about_feature_composite_shelves: Stack several sources into one shelf: show games from any source, or only the ones that appear in all of them
about_feature_asset_refresh: Custom artwork (capsule, logo, hero, icon) refreshes the moment you return to home — no plugin reload
about_report_copied: Diagnostics copied — paste them into the report
